topic: Live metrics vs. Recalculated impression data
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the feasibility of displaying live metrics, specifically viewed impressions and dwell time, on a screen. It was determined that while truly live data is difficult due to potential discrepancies with recalculated totals (recalc), presenting an updated total for a shorter period (e.g., last hour) is possible.

Regarding data accuracy, the difference between live views and recalculation will be minimal after implementing changes when transitioning to `agg_6`. The discussion concluded by addressing technical issues related to MAC address verification.
decisions: Live metrics (viewed impressions/dwell time) can be displayed as an updated total for a limited period, though it may cause freezing if the full day is attempted.
action_items: Investigate displaying live viewed impression data via an endpoint provided by Broadsign.
Verify MAC address existence in the trusted database.
